Taylor (People Ops): Quick ping 1: we've published a short policy refresh (handbook section on leave, bereavement, and flexible work). Managers need to confirm they've reviewed and that direct reports finish the 12-min micro-course by Aug 2. Tracker & office-hours link in the sheet.

Asha (HR Ops): Link?

Taylor (People Ops): Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/policy-ack-aug2026. Confluence summary: https://confluence.redwood.ai/handbook/aug-2026-refresh

Ben (Legal): Reviewed. I simplified the religious accommodation clause and added an example in the FAQ to avoid confusion.

Ravi (Recruiting): Note: update offer language for part-time leave eligibility. I'll push changes to the offers repo today.

Liam (Eng Manager): Can managers mark teams as "acknowledged" once everyone completes training?

Taylor (People Ops): Yes, but please only mark after you verify completion. We'll run a quick audit sample. There's also an option to request a private 15-min manager walkthrough in the tracker.

nudge-bot: Reminder scheduled: First nudge Jul 19, follow-up Jul 26, final Jul 31 (status: queued).

Asha (HR Ops): I've added a column for "accommodation requests" so managers can flag cases that need People Ops + Legal help.

Ben (Legal): I'll draft a short blurb for manager talking points addressing phased returns and contractor conversions.

Liam (Eng Manager): Thanks 1. I'll put this on my team's next stand-up and book the 10am walkthrough if spots remain.

Taylor (People Ops): Great. Final: training due Aug 2, manager confirmations by Aug 6. Ping here if you need slides or a live walk-through.
__notes: Single Slack thread. Messages are short, chronological, and prefixed by sender display names. Tracker/confluence links are placeholders.
